FactGapSection.description:
A fact the page needs and we lack: one Inbox question, never a blocker.

The private draft renders ``question`` as a marked prompt (``variant`` is
pinned to ``gap_prompt`` so a renderer can style it). Any published or
indexable render drops this section or replaces it with ``fallback``; see
``gap_page_manifest.published_gap_page_manifest``. A ``fact_gap`` never
refuses a build or a publish, and it never states a company fact: its
``question`` is our prompt and its ``fallback`` is general prose, so neither
is claim-bearing.
FactGapSection.title: FactGapSection
